name: Sunny Moon Village
shortDescription: A gated community of single-storey villas in Nai Harn from Sunny Development Group, with 2, 3 and 4 bedroom homes of about 149 to 215 sqm.
description: A gated community of single-storey villas in Nai Harn from Sunny Development Group, with 2, 3 and 4 bedroom homes of about 149 to 215 sqm. Each villa has its own pool and sunrise-facing orientation, and residents share the wellness and sports amenities of the neighbouring Sunny Moon project.
